statement: K5-e marked-cross-edge (b,e) component theorem. On the stabilizer slice a=c=d=1, let alpha=-1+sqrt(10)/4. The complete component of P>0 containing (1,1) is exactly e>alpha and b>-C(e)/A(e); xi is strictly positive throughout it.
closes: complete distinguished-component classification and strict xi positivity on the natural a=c=d=1, free-(b,e) slice
dependency_gaps: free c or other released stabilizer variables
